We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.  What We Do  The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.  About The Role  GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Data Science AI Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.  Although every project is unique, you might typically:   Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare)  Create problems requiring Python programming to solve (using pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn)  Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)  Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains in data processing, statistical analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and insight extraction  Create deterministic problems with reproducible answers: avoid stochastic elements or require fixed random seeds for exact reproducibility  Base problems on real business challenges: customer analytics, risk assessment, fraud detection, forecasting, optimization, and operational efficiency  Design end-to-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations)  Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches  Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods  Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers.    How To Get Started  Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.  Requirements   You hold a Master's or PhD Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.  You have at least 5 years of hands‑on data science experience with proven business impact  You have a portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real‑world problem‑solving.  You are proficient in python programming for data science (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit‑learn, statsmodels).  You are an expert in statistical analysis and machine learning with deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications.  You are proficient in SQL and database operations for data manipulation and analysis  You have experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases)  You have good understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows  You possess knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)  Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above  You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines  Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge    Benefits  Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?   Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $21/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs  Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments  Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio  Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Active Directory Expert
description:
Empresa está contratando Active Directory Expert em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Active Directory Expert to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the organization's Active Directory (AD) infrastructure, ensuring its security, performance, and reliability. You’ll be part of a huge program, including the transformation of the AD operating model. You will also provide your expertise on troubleshooting, configuring, and optimizing Active Directory infrastructure, as well as supporting key initiatives related to identity and access management. The ideal candidate will have deep knowledge of Active Directory. A proactive approach to problem-solving, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team are essential. Responsibilities Active Directory Management:  administer and maintain Active Directory domains. Security & Access Control:  implement and enforce Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and security best practices to ensure the integrity of Active Directory services. Remediate security issues and implement security measures to protect Active Directory, increase security posture. Ensure compliance with security policies and standards. Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution:  as the expert, help resolving Active Directory-related issues, including login problems, replication errors, and integration issues. Active Directory Health & Performance:  ensure monitoring and maintain the health of AD infrastructure. Directory Integration & Federation:  Integrate Active Directory with other enterprise systems, applications, and cloud-based services (e.g., Microsoft 365, Entra ID). Backup & Disaster Recovery:  ensure effective backup and recovery processes for Active Directory, including disaster recovery planning and testing. Documentation & Reporting:  Create and maintain documentation on AD configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures. Build regular & automated reports on AD health and security. Continuous Improvement:  stay current with the latest Active Directory best practices, tools, and security trends. Recommend improvements and optimizations to enhance system efficiency  Qualifications A bachelor\u2019s degree or higher in computer science, information security, or a related field. Hands-on experience working with Active Directory environments. Proven experience with Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), AD replication, Group Policy Management, and AD security features. Experience with integrating AD with cloud-based services (e.g., Entra ID, Office 365, etc.). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to handle complex and ambiguous situations. Strong project management, with the ability to report efficiently and deliver results on time. Highly motivated, self-driven, and adaptable, and the ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.  At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future. Conhecimento sólido em marketing digital, campanhas de CRM e performance.  Familiaridade com práticas de mercado de CRM, CRO e Loyalty. So, if you’re passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi‑cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let’s contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.  About the Role  The Risk Manager (AVP) will strengthen the company’s risk management framework, with focus on financial risks , and regulatory reporting for a financial institution in Brazil. This role plays a critical function in ensuring robust risk practices, aligned with Banco Central do Brasil (Bacen)  requirements, internal risk appetite, and group standards. Experience in designing risk processes for regulatory authorization is a strong advantage.  Responsibilities   Develop, enhance, and maintain the Enterprise Risk Management Framework, ensuring alignment with BCB, CMN Resolutions, and group risk standards.  Define and update risk policies, risk appetite statements (RAS), and risk taxonomy.  Support risk governance forums, including preparation of materials for Risk Committees and Board‑level reporting.  Lead risk assessment models, monitoring, and controls across lending products, investments, credit, and FIDC structures.  Oversee operational risk management, including risk & control self‑assessments (RCSA), incident reporting, KRI monitoring, third‑party risk, and business continuity aspects.  Evaluate new products, initiatives, and partnerships, conducting Risk & Compliance Assessment (RCA) and issuing signoffs.  Coordinate periodic submissions to Bacen, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards.  Prepare risk‑related regulatory documentation and respond to RFIs, audits, and supervisory requests.  Support the company’s regulatory authorization process, including designing risk controls tailored for licensing requirements.  Develop and enhance risk dashboards, models, and automated reporting for credit, operational, and financial risk indicators.  Use data insights to inform business decisions and risk mitigation strategies.    Skills, Experiences & Qualifications   Hands‑on leadership style with the ability to make sound technical decisions.  Experience in structuring risk process for financial or payment institutions , including regulatory compliance requirements.  Bachelor's degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.  7+ years of experience in Risk functions within financial institutions, fintechs or risk metrics platforms.  Strong knowledge of Bacen and CMN regulations (ex.: Res. 4.557, 4.970, 4.953).  Prior involvement in Bacen authorization/licensing projects  is highly valued. title: Messaging Operations Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Messaging Operations Manager em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.  About Us  Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry‑first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.  We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top‑notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2,000+ customers from high‑growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and more.  Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman‑founded, women‑led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need.  From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world‑class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.  Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.  Messaging Operations Manager  We are looking for a dynamic and experienced individual to join Insider One and support our Revenue Operations team as a Messaging Operations Manager, specifically focusing on our messaging and WhatsApp products. In this role, you will play a crucial part in driving profits, optimizing deal execution, and managing vendor negotiations. You will be responsible for pricing checks, negotiating special pricing with vendors, and collaborating closely with the sales team to ensure smooth deal execution. Your expertise in vendor management and pricing will be vital for the success of the messaging and WhatsApp product lines.  Additionally, you will drive process enhancements and ensure that our pricing and deal structuring align with the company’s overall goals. Your negotiation skills will help maintain a seamless process from quoting to deal closure, while ensuring compliance with both internal policies and external regulations.  What You Will Do   Vendor Negotiation and Pricing Management   Lead pricing checks and negotiate special pricing with SMS and WhatsApp vendors.  Secure competitive pricing from vendors, ensuring profitability and operational efficiency.  Work closely with the sales team to collaborate on pricing, deal structuring, and contract terms.  Manage vendor relationships to maintain favorable terms and high service levels.  Deal Execution and Rev Ops Collaboration   Support the Revenue Operations team in driving profitability and optimizing deal execution.  Ensure compliance with internal booking policies and external regulations during deal structuring.  Collaborate with sales teams and other key stakeholders to ensure smooth deal execution.  Assist in onboarding new sales reps and providing training on quoting tools and CRM systems.  Operational Efficiency and Process Enhancements   Implement and manage dashboards or reporting tools to monitor deal performance, pricing efficiency, and vendor relationships.  Drive process improvements that enhance the team’s scalability and efficiency.  Monitor key metrics related to pricing performance, deal closure rates, and vendor management.  Market & Trend Analysis   Analyze market trends to ensure that pricing remains competitive across different regions.  Provide insights on SMS and WhatsApp pricing dynamics to inform strategic decisions.  Stay up to date on industry benchmarks to ensure Insider One maintains its competitive edge.    What You Will Need   2-8 years of experience in deal desk operations, pricing, or related areas.  Strong negotiation and people skills with a proven track record of vendor management.  Familiarity with CRM systems and quoting tools.  Experience with messaging and WhatsApp products is a plus.  Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.  Ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.  Comfortable in a fast‑paced environment, capable of managing tight deadlines.    What We Offer   Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.  Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.  Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.  Become a Shareowner through our eligibility‑based "ESOP" and own a piece of what you build.  Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.  Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose‑driven social impact projects.  From global retreats to team‑building activities, expect year‑round events that turn into lifelong memories.    We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.  To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.  If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.  We provide equal opportunity in a zero‑discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.  Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Diferenciais :    Conhecimento ou vivência em ISO 2701 (Sistema de Gestão de Segurança da Informação);  Experiência prévia como Tech Lead, coordenador ou referência técnica;  Vivência com gerenciamento de frota em larga escala (milhares de dispositivos);  Conhecimento de J1939 (veículos pesados);  Experiência com OTA/FOTA, rollback e controle de versões em campo;  Conhecimento em processos de certificação ANATEL, PTCRB ou OEMs automotivos;  Experiência com Python para automação de testes, geração de relatórios ou ferramentas internas;  Background em hardware, testes de bancada, análise de consumo e RF;  Habilidade com ferramentas de observabilidade e telemetria IoT.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Com sedes em Blumenau, Brusque, Itajaí, Rio do Sul, Florianópolis e Timbó, atendemos a 75 municípios de Santa Catarina e realizamos o acompanhamento pré e pós-transplante de pacientes em todo o Brasil. Vagas de copywriter não faltam no mercado. Então por que considerar esta?   Você escreve para pessoas, não para marcas.  Cada cliente tem nome, rosto, opiniões e uma história. É ghostwriting no sentido mais puro: dar voz a quem tem muito a dizer, mas não tem tempo de escrever.  Seus textos serão lidos por milhares de pessoas.  Os perfis que a BYU gerencia têm audiência real. O que você escreve gera comentários, abre conversas e traz negócios. O impacto é visível toda semana.  Ferramentas, não burocracia.  IA paga, treinamentos internos e feedback constante do Head de Conteúdo. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento porque isso se reflete diretamente na qualidade da entrega.  Crescimento concreto. R$ 4.000 a R$ 6.000/mês , conforme experiência e portfólio.  Treinamentos internos:  investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo, não apenas nas entregas  Horário flexível:  o que importa é a qualidade da entrega, não o horário em que você trabalha  Recesso e férias remuneradas:  mesmo no modelo PJ    O Bom e o Mau Copywriter de LinkedIn  O Bom Copywriter  estuda o cliente antes de escrever a primeira linha. Lê as entrevistas que ele concedeu, assiste aos vídeos, entende como ele se comunica. O resultado é um conteúdo que parece ter saído diretamente do executivo, não de uma agência.  O Mau Copywriter  troca o nome no template e envia para aprovação. O cliente lê e percebe que aquilo não o representa.  O Bom Copywriter  sabe que as duas primeiras linhas decidem o alcance de um post. Testa aberturas diferentes, analisa o desempenho da semana anterior e ajusta.  O Mau Copywriter  troca as mesmas aberturas repetidamente, não consulta métricas e não compreende por que o engajamento está caindo.  O Bom Copywriter  utiliza IA para ganhar velocidade, não para substituir o raciocínio. Gera rascunhos, pesquisa referências e testa variações. Mas o texto final passou por revisão humana cuidadosa.  O Mau Copywriter  copia a saída da IA, formata e entrega. O cliente — ou qualquer leitor atento — percebe imediatamente.  O Bom Copywriter  escreve com correção gramatical e tom adequado ao LinkedIn: profissional, porém conversacional. Encontra o equilíbrio entre formalidade e naturalidade.  O Mau Copywriter  ou adota um tom excessivamente formal (como um release de assessoria) ou relaxa a ponto de deixar erros passarem. Erros em conteúdos de CEOs comprometem tanto a agência quanto o cliente.  O Bom Copywriter  gerencia o próprio calendário. Cumpre prazos, comunica proativamente quando precisa de mais tempo e não confunde briefings entre clientes.  O Mau Copywriter  atrasa entregas, mistura informações de clientes diferentes e depende de cobranças constantes. Com 4 a 10 clientes simultâneos, esse perfil não se sustenta.  O Bom Copywriter  busca feedback ativamente e ajusta sem resistência. Entende que os primeiros textos de cada cliente fazem parte do processo de calibragem. Cada rodada de revisão é uma oportunidade de evoluir.  O Mau Copywriter  interpreta correções como crítica pessoal. Defende o texto em vez de ouvir o cliente e repete os mesmos problemas.  Em resumo:  buscamos alguém que trate cada perfil de cliente como se a reputação em jogo fosse a própria. Que compreenda que um post no LinkedIn de um CEO não é apenas conteúdo — é posicionamento. Se isso faz sentido para você, queremos conversar.  Diversidade & Inclusão  Nossas vagas são abertas a todas as pessoas, sem distinção de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica.  Candidate-se pela Candidatura Simplificada do LinkedIn.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale. description:

O grande desafio como CX Designer será realizar o entendimento aprofundado do fluxo de negócio e garantir a rastreabilidade e medição de toda a experiência por meio de tagueamento (instrumentação) de dados na jornada do cliente. Este profissional atuará como guardião da experiência, transformando dados em insights para desenhar fluxos mais eficientes, intuitivos e que gerem maior satisfação e conversão. Nosso parceiro da área de Seguros busca constantemente aprimorar o design e a operação dos sistemas para garantir que sejam mais escaláveis, confiáveis e eficientes. Então, o papel da pessoa CX Designer é bastante estratégico para o negócio. Para que a estratégia seja assertiva, a pessoa CX Designer fará parte de uma equipe ágil composta por Desenvolvedores, Líderes Técnicos, Analistas de QA, Analistas Funcionais, Product Owners (PO) e Scrum Masters. Garantir a Rastreabilidade da Jornada: O desafio central é desenhar e documentar detalhadamente o tagueamento (instrumentação de dados) em cada ponto de interação da jornada (WhatsApp/Chatbot), garantindo que todos os eventos e gargalos do cliente sejam corretamente identificados e mensurados para análise de dados e Business Intelligence. Otimização Contínua do Fluxo: Identificar e reprojetar os pontos de fricção (pain points), drop-offs e repetição de ciclos na jornada, transformando interações complexas em experiências fluidas e de baixo esforço. Equilibrar Automação e Experiência Humana: Desenhar flows que maximizem a resolução de problemas por automação, mas que garantam uma transição suave e eficiente para o atendimento humano quando necessário, mantendo a voz e a personalidade da marca. Tradução de Requisitos de Negócio em UX Funcional: Converter objetivos de negócio complexos em arquiteturas conversacionais e fluxos de usuário simples e compreensíveis. Requisitos Empatia e Customer Centricity: Capacidade genuína de se colocar no lugar do usuário para identificar pontos de dor e oportunidades de melhoria. Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Clareza para articular insights, defender propostas de design e interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Negociação e Persuasão: Habilidade para influenciar o roadmap do produto e negociar soluções de design que equilibrem a experiência do cliente com os objetivos de negócio e as restrições técnicas. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes dinâmicos e lidar com feedbacks e iterações rápidas, mantendo o foco na melhoria contínua. Organização e Gestão de Fluxo: Proficiência em documentar, organizar e gerenciar a complexidade de fluxos de conversação e jornadas do usuário. Liderança e Proatividade: Iniciativa para conduzir pesquisas, propor soluções e atuar como líder de pensamento em UX dentro da equipe.  Requisitos técnicos (hard skills) Experiência Comprovada em Design Conversacional (Conversational UX/CUX): Sólida experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais. Mapeamento de Jornada e Fluxos: Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade. Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics): Experiência em definir a estratégia e os requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de UX e negócio (ex: Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso, CSAT conversacional). Prototipação e Testes: Proficiência em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro ou similar) e experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, A/B testing e análise heurística em canais conversacionais. Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp: Familiaridade com as limitações e capacidades de plataformas populares de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business. UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para fundamentar decisões de design (entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação, pesquisa de satisfação). Conceitos Ágeis: Experiência de trabalho em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração estreita com Product Owners (PO) e engenheiros.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

This role will oversee the entire revenue lifecycle across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and Customer Success Ops, ensuring alignment, efficiency, and growth across each stage of the customer journey.  As part of Doctoralia, the leading digital healthcare platform in Brazil and part of the Docplanner Group, you will play a key role in unlocking scalable growth by enabling data-driven decisions, optimizing operational processes, and ensuring seamless execution across go-to-market functions.  Responsibilities   Own the end-to-end revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment;  Partner with Marketing, Sales, and CS leadership to design, execute, and optimize lead-to-revenue processes;  Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and forecasting tools to track funnel performance, conversion rates, and growth drivers;  Lead systems and tooling enhancements (CRM, marketing automation, customer platforms) to enable scalability and visibility;  Identify operational bottlenecks and lead cross-functional initiatives to solve them;  Create lead scoring, routing, and segmentation logic to improve acquisition efficiency;  Design playbooks and workflows to drive adoption and retention across the funnel;  Ensure governance, data hygiene, and operational rigor across revenue platforms;    Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or similar (MBA is a plus);  Solid experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Growth Operations roles;  Experience managing cross-functional revenue funnels (Marketing → Sales → CS);  Proficiency in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive), BI tools (Looker, Tableau), and Excel/Google Sheets;  Strong analytical and modeling skills (SQL or data querying is a plus);  Fluency in Portuguese; business English required.    Key Competencies   Analytical Thinking: Able to interpret data to inform strategy and drive decisions;  Revenue Orientation: Understands the full funnel impact of operations on growth;  Process Optimization: Passion for reducing inefficiencies and building scalable systems;  Collaboration: Skilled at aligning cross-functional stakeholders and driving action;  Ownership Mentality: Bias toward execution and continuous improvement. title: Executivo de vendas
description:

Executivo(a) de Vendas    Estamos assessorando o G4 Educação na busca por um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas que pense além da meta e venda com propósito.   No G4, vender não é apenas fechar um contrato — é abrir possibilidades. Mais do que uma escola de negócios, somos um movimento de transformação econômica. Já impactamos positivamente a geração de centenas de milhares de empregos, e nossa meta é ousada: criar 1 milhão de novos empregos no Brasil até 2030. Acreditamos que uma venda bem conduzida muda o rumo de uma empresa — e o de todo um ecossistema ao seu redor.  O que buscamos  Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com visão estratégica, forte habilidade de negociação e paixão por gerar valor real através da educação. Alguém que compreenda que vender é, sobretudo, escutar, diagnosticar e construir soluções personalizadas para quem está na linha de frente dos negócios: founders, sócios e executivos.  Sobre o papel  Você irá atuar com leads inbound qualificados — muitos deles empreendedores de alto impacto — oferecendo soluções educacionais que geram resultados mensuráveis e sustentáveis. A atuação é 100% consultiva e estratégica, com foco em relacionamento, geração de valor e performance.  Suas principais missões serão:   Realizar entrevistas diagnósticas com leads inbound para mapear dores de gestão, crescimento e operação;  Conduzir conversas de venda com escuta ativa, foco em impacto e construção de valor real;  Elaborar propostas personalizadas com precisão, estratégia e agilidade;  Negociar com tomadores de decisão, apresentando argumentos orientados a ROI e performance;  Atuar com autonomia, consistência e método em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta performance.    Esperamos que você tenha:   Comunicação verbal e escrita de altíssimo nível, com clareza e empatia;  Experiência sólida em inside sales, especialmente B2B e alto ticket;  Pensamento analítico e visão estratégica aplicados ao processo comercial;  Maturidade emocional, resiliência e entusiasmo diante de metas ambiciosas;  Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM (HubSpot é um diferencial).    Diferenciais que valorizamos:   Vivência em startups, edtechs ou empresas SaaS;  Experiência com público C-Level ou founders;  Conhecimento prévio sobre os programas e metodologias da G4 Educação;  Inglês intermediário ou avançado. Se você acredita que vender pode ser um ato de transformação e que educação é uma das maiores ferramentas de mudança social e econômica, talvez essa oportunidade seja a extensão natural da sua jornada.  #Vagas #G4Educação #ExecutivoDeVendas #VendasConsultivas #PresencialSP #TimeG4 #EducaçãoExecutiva #LinkedInJobs #rhellorh #Closer #BDR #SDR  Get notified about new Sales Executive jobs in São Paulo, Brazil .   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Remote Senior Sales Representative
description:

Join to apply for the Remote Senior Sales Representative  role at THE/STUDIO   Global Talent Acquisition Partner | Startup Hiring  Remote – Open to candidates from anywhere in the world    Latin America preferred due to timezone alignment    Working hours: US Pacific Time    Sales experience required, with strong English communication skills  About Us  At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.  Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote  working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.  All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!  We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!  The Role  At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.  We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.  As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.  What You’ll Do   Consult with inbound leads to deeply understand customer goals, timelines, and long‑term needs.  Apply a consultative sales approach to guide customers through design, pricing, and production decisions.  Own and manage customer accounts with a focus on nurturing repeat business and long‑term value.  Maintain a structured, self‑driven sales workflow with clear follow‑up cadences and prioritization.  Manage your pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and strong CRM hygiene.  Confidently handle objections and position THE/STUDIO as the trusted alternative to “cheap but risky” sourcing options.  Collaborate closely with the Sales Team Lead, Production, and Design teams to ensure smooth handoffs and accurate execution.  Oversee order tracking, delivery coordination, and post‑sale follow‑ups to strengthen customer relationships.  Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.  Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.    What Success Looks Like  Within Your First Month    Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.  Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.  Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.    Within 3 Months    Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.  Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.  Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.  Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.  Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.     Within 6 Months    Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.  Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.  Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.  Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.     What We’re Looking For   3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).  Strong foundation in consultative sales (Account Executive–type experience preferred).  Proven ability to manage and nurture customer accounts and generate repeat business.  Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.  Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).  High energy, professional presence, and strong video communication skills.  Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.  Interest in apparel, custom products, or manufacturing is a strong plus.  Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.  Highly organized with strong CRM discipline (HubSpot experience is a plus).  Self‑starter who thrives in a remote, fast‑moving startup environment.  Comfortable working US hours (PST and EST).  Remote‑ready setup: laptop/desktop with at least 8GB RAM, stable internet (10 Mbps+), and a quiet workspace for customer calls.    Note: This role is not suited for appointment setters, BDR‑only profiles, or candidates transitioning into sales from non‑sales backgrounds.  Why You’ll Love It Here   Fast‑growing company redefining custom manufacturing.  High‑quality inbound leads. NO heavy cold calling.  Clear metrics, dashboards, and performance transparency.  Real growth opportunities for top performers.  Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions.  Personalized sales training to support both your role and long‑term career growth.  No micromanagement: we trust experienced sellers to own their work.       On‑target earnings (OTE): $2,200+ per month (base + uncapped commissions)   Additional Attributes & Process   Intellectually curious  – possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right  Self‑motivated  with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence  Good communication skills  that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team  Radical candor  – coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable  Operates with a level of urgency  – values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision‑making, swift problem‑solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment  Natural customer centricity  – has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias toward talking to the customer to understand them  Results‑driven  – focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives  Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English  Video Question  Written Assessment and Mock Call  CEO Interview  Reference Check    Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Regardless of the result, we always inform candidates via email.  Equal Opportunity Statement  At THE/STUDIO, we know that our Company’s strength lies in the diversity of our team. THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Our policy is to provide equal opportunities for all applicants and individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We prioritize and maintain a fair, inclusive and equitable workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.  ***No third‑party recruiters/agencies please  Seniority level  Associate  Employment type  Full‑time  Job function  Sales and Customer Service  Industries  Internet Marketplace Platforms, Design Services, and Marketing Services  Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at THE/STUDIO by 2x   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Minimum qualifications   Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.  7 years of experience in advertising sales, marketing, consulting, or media (e.g., search, social, mobile, display, and video media).  7 years of experience creating and presenting customer-facing materials (e.g., pitches, narratives, or one-sheets) for sales teams.  7 years of experience in consumer and market insights, media measurement, and privacy landscape.  Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders.    Preferred qualifications   10 years of experience with social media insights data analytics.  Experience in product Go-to-Market (GTM) or commercial strategy roles.  Expertise in the Brazilian media market, including a sophisticated understanding of the TV ecosystem, viewership trends, and the competitive landscape of local broadcasters and streamers.    About The Job  Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today\'s dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.  As the YouTube Ads Strategy Lead, you will serve as the primary architect for YouTube’s product and business generation strategy in Brazil. Sitting at the intersection of Product and Sales, you function as a Product Lead within a commercial structure, driving the long-term roadmap for how YouTube competes for and wins advertising budgets.  Your strategy will be rooted in a deep, holistic understanding of the platform’s ecosystem—starting from user consumption behavior to inform monetization frameworks. You will be the go-to expert on the Brazilian media landscape, leveraging deep knowledge from traditional TV to social platforms dynamics to position YouTube as the premier choice for advertisers. You will translate complex internal data into actionable business intelligence, crafting the narratives that drive video products adoption and revenue growth.  Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.  Responsibilities   Centralize YouTube’s business generation strategy in Brazil, acting as the bridge between local sales and global teams.  Build a platform outlook based on user behavior, arming sales with data-driven narratives that connect consumption patterns to brand buying strategies.  Co-lead the annual plan, prioritizing and communicating Brazil’s business requirements to global product and engineering stakeholders.  Analyze data and market trends to identify opportunities, developing strategies to reach business goals.    Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning
description:
Confira a vaga para Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Latitude.sh  Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.  We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single‑tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.  Summary  The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.  Key Responsibilities   Capacity Planning & Forecasting  Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.  Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.  Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.  Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.  Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis  Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.  Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.  Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.  Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.  Operational Reporting & Insights  Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.  Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.  Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.  Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.    Skills And Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).  2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.  Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).  Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.  Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).  Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).    Preferred   Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.  Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.  Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.  Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.  Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences.  Collaborative and dependable, thriving in a dynamic, global environment.    What do we offer?   Competitive Compensation  Annual Bonus based on company and team performance  Meal voucher (Caju): R$805,22/monthly  Wellhub  Transportation or fuel voucher (without discounts)  Health Plan (Sulamérica)  Dental Plan (Amil)  Subsidies for education, certification and English courses  On‑site at Vila Mariana - São Paulo - SP    Why Latitude.sh?  We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem‑solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.  Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:
Nova oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro - São Paulo (Comercial) em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Quer entrar para o mercado financeiro auxiliando as pessoas a atingir os seus objetivos de vida da melhor forma possível? O Planejamento Financeiro pode ser para você.  Sobre Nós  A Braúna Planejamento Financeiro nasceu em 2022 em parceria com um dos 10 maiores escritórios de investimentos da XP: a Braúna. Com mais de R$ 9 bilhões sob custódia, a Braúna compreendeu que o acesso à educação financeira seria um diferencial para seus clientes. Após 3 anos de existência, a Braúna Planejamento já auxiliou mais de 1.500 clientes e continua sua missão de transformar sonhos em realidade.  Nossos Valores   Ética e Transparência: não utilizamos atalhos. Nosso foco é sempre o cliente!  Entregar Resultados com Eficiência: buscamos pessoas engajadas e que são orientadas a resultados;  Leveza e Proximidade: levamos o assunto de finanças de uma forma acessível e tranquila aos nossos clientes e parceiros;  Vibrar juntos em todos os momentos: comemoramos as conquistas de nossos clientes como se fossem nossas. Afinal, o sucesso deles é o nosso sucesso;  Desenvolvimento Contínuo: estamos abertos para mudar, sempre baseados em fatos e dados e dispostos a corrigir.    Se identificou com a nossa cultura? Então vamos realizar sonhos juntos!  Sobre a Vaga  Auxiliar as pessoas a tomarem as melhores decisões na hora de: comprar um imóvel, investir para a aposentadoria, saber gerir melhor seus ganhos, controlar melhor as despesas, planejar a tão sonhada viagem são algumas das atribuições de Planejadores Financeiros.  Estamos buscando um profissional apaixonado por ajudar pessoas, que sejam entusiastas da área financeira e com habilidades comerciais afiadas para se juntar à nossa equipe. Nesta função, você será responsável por proporcionar um atendimento excepcional aos nossos clientes, combinando suas habilidades técnicas com as habilidades comerciais.  Sua principal missão será implantar nossa metodologia na vida financeira dos clientes, orientando-os rumo aos seus objetivos financeiros.  Principais Responsabilidades   Realizar prospecção de clientes;  Realizar a gestão da carteira de clientes;  Elaboração e desenvolvimento de estratégias financeiras adequadas ao perfil e objetivos dos clientes;  Apresentação de planejamento financeiro;  Acompanhamento dos clientes ao longo de seu planejamento financeiro para uma implementação eficaz do plano de ação;    Para essa vaga é diferencial   Experiência/Certificações do mercado financeiro (CPA-10 / CPA-20 / CEA / CFP);  Experiência na área comercial;  Gostar de desafios;    E você? Gostou da ideia? Se inscreva em nosso processo seletivo para te conhecermos melhor.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Compras Aeronáuticas
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista de Compras Aeronáuticas em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Uma empresa de referência no setor de transporte aéreo, reconhecida pela excelência em atendimento. Com o apoio estratégico de Claire Joster, especialista em recrutamento, buscamos um profissional técnico para integrar nossa equipe de suprimentos e contribuir para operações de alta performance e segurança.  Objetivo da Posição  Responsável pela gestão estratégica de compras de peças, componentes, equipamentos e serviços críticos para a operação e manutenção aeronáutica. O profissional garantirá o equilíbrio entre custo, qualidade e conformidade, assegurando o suporte contínuo às operações de voo e à manutenção da frota, em linha com as rígidas normas do setor (ANAC, FAA, EASA).  Responsabilidades e Atribuições   Executar todo o ciclo de compras: identificação de necessidade, cotação, negociação, aquisição e acompanhamento de entregas de materiais aeronáuticos e serviços especializados.  Analisar especificações técnicas e desenhos de engenharia para validar a conformidade de itens com os requisitos de segurança e qualidade.  Desenvolver e gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores homologados nacionais e internacionais, assegurando performance e parcerias estratégicas.  Elaborar e administrar contratos de fornecimento, com atenção a cláusulas técnicas, de segurança e comerciais.  Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de Engenharia, Manutenção (MRO) e Planejamento para alinhar demandas, prazos e especificações.  Implementar iniciativas de redução de custos e otimização de processos de suprimentos, sem comprometer a integridade operacional.  Gerenciar os níveis de estoque de peças críticas, prevenindo situações de ruptura (AOG – Aircraft on Ground) e otimizando o capital.  Assegurar a conformidade de todos os processos com as regulamentações aeronáuticas vigentes e com os procedimentos internos de qualidade e segurança.  Dominar o uso de sistemas de gestão (ERP, SAP) e plataformas especializadas do setor (ex.: ILS, AeroXchange) para cadastro, rastreamento e aquisição de peças.  Atuar como ponto de contato técnico-comercial para resolver problemas de qualidade, atrasos ou não-conformidades com fornecedores.    Requisitos Obrigatórios   Formação:  Bacharelado em Engenharia (Aeronáutica, Mecânica, Produção, Materiais ou áreas correlatas).  Experiência Comprovada  em funções de compras, suprimentos ou supply chain no setor de transporte aéreo, aviação ou aeroespacial .  Conhecimento sólido das normas regulatórias da aviação civil (ANAC, FAA, EASA).  Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de documentação técnica (manuais, catálogos de peças, desenhos) em inglês .  Habilidade avançada em ferramentas de gestão e análise: ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS) e Excel (funções complexas, dashboards).  Competências sólidas em negociação estratégica, análise de custos e gestão de contratos.  Perfil proativo, analítico e com orientação rigorosa para detalhes, essencial em um ambiente de alta criticidade.    Diferenciais (Desejáveis)   Pós-graduação ou certificações em Compras, Supply Chain Management ou Gestão de Projetos.  Experiência com processos de importação/exportação de peças aeronáuticas e trâmites aduaneiros.  Conhecimento em sistemas de catálogos de peças aeronáuticas (PartsBase, Inventory Locator Service).  Vivência em processos de homologação e auditoria de fornecedores no setor aeroespacial.  Inglês fluente para comunicação comercial e técnica com fornecedores internacionais.    Competências Comportamentais   Pensamento Crítico e Resolução de Problemas:  capacidade de tomar decisões ágeis e precisas sob pressão.  Comunicação Efetiva:  habilidade para dialogar com diferentes áreas (técnicas e comerciais) e níveis hierárquicos.  Ética e Integridade Inegociáveis , aderente à cultura de segurança e compliance da aviação.  Organização e Orientação a Prazos:  disciplina para gerenciar múltiplas demandas críticas simultaneamente.  Trabalho em Equipe:  espírito colaborativo para atuar em um ambiente multidisciplinar e dinâmico.  Plano de saúde e odontológico extensivo à família;  Vale-refeição e/ou vale-alimentação;  Seguro de vida;  Previdência privada;  Auxílio home office ou auxílio-transporte (conforme modelo);  Programa de bonificação por resultados;  Possibilidade de participação em treinamentos e certificações do setor;  Ambiente de inovação com suporte de especialistas como Claire Joster.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Banco de Talentos / Pilar e CEDIP
description:

Somos éticos e agimos com transparência, tratamos todos como queremos ser tratados, buscamos a excelência e acreditamos na meritocracia, construímos relações de longo prazo e lideramos pelo exemplo. 🤗  Estamos em busca de TALENTOS que desejem se desenvolver, romper barreiras e crescer junto conosco 🚀  Se você tem formação em Técnico de Enfermagem e atua na área hospitalar da saúde, essa vaga é para você!     Responsabilidades e atribuições  MISSÃO:   Realizar procedimentos e assistência de enfermagem aos pacientes da instituição, em tratamento clínico e/ou cirúrgico, envolvendo atividades de nível técnico com objetivo de assegurar a qualidade da assistência prestada e garantir a segurança do paciente.  Principais Responsabilidades    Preparar os pacientes para exames;  Realizar cuidados de higiene e de alimentação dos pacientes;  Preparar o paciente para transferência de unidade;  Participar do transporte de pacientes;  Realizar o registro dos parâmetros assistenciais.  Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;  Trabalhar em conformidade com os protocolos assistenciais do Pilar Hospital;  Atuar de forma colaborativa e integrada com a equipe assistencial da UTI, Unidades de Internação, Centro Cirúrgico, Pronto Atendimento e CME.  E demais funções do cargo. Requisitos e qualificações   Registro ativo no COREN-PR como Técnico de Enfermagem;  Desejável experiência em hospitalar;  Desejável conhecimento no Sistema Tasy.  Disponibilidade para atuar em diferentes setores do hospital     Informações adicionais  A Hospital Care/Pilar Hospital zela por sua qualidade de vida, por isso temos um cuidado especial com vocês:   VT (Vale Transporte);  Convênio com estacionamento;  VA (Vale Alimentação);  Plano Saúde Unimed (após experiência de 90 dias);  Plano Odontológico;  Alimentação no local;  Seguro de vida;  Convênio com instituições de ensino;  Gympass.      #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Represent the company as a regional executive and primary liaison with institutional partners, regulators, and stakeholders. title: Representante Regional de Vendas Externas (Canais Offline | Beleza & Cosméticos)
description:

Atuamos com um modelo competitivo na cadeia de suprimentos, para distribuidores, atacadistas, perfumarias, drogarias e grandes redes de varejo, marketplaces e e-commerce. Nosso foco é construir crescimento sustentável, escala nacional e presença estruturada das marcas nos principais canais de distribuição. Você será responsável por gerir, desenvolver e ampliar uma carteira multicanal, que vai desde grandes polos de massa até plataformas digitais, garantindo capilaridade nacional através do varejo, atacado e distribuição. title: Facilitador de engajamento
description:
Confira a vaga para Facilitador de engajamento em foz do iguaçu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O Parque das Aves é uma das únicas instituições do mundo focada na conservação de espécies da Mata Atlântica, imersivo e encantador. Visitando o Parque das Aves você também conhece o que fazemos para ajudar a reverter a crise de conservação que as espécies da Mata Atlântica estão vivendo. Aqui você pode ter uma experiência completa de conexão e conhecimento sobre os animais e o bioma, um patrimônio natural de importância global.   Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e unir esforços para que juntos possamos cumprir o propósito de cuidar da Nossa Mata Atlântica e suas espécies.   Responsabilidades:   Realizar a mediação educativa em viveiros de imersão e demais espaços da trilha do Parque das Aves, monitorando as interações entre público e animais e assegurando que sejam seguras e encantadoras;  Realizar e supervisionar as atividades das experiências com alimentação de animais executadas pelos visitantes, mediando e garantindo segurança para todos os envolvidos;  Realizar visitas guiadas, visitas técnicas e visitas especiais para públicos diversos, em diferentes idiomas, garantindo atendimento de excelência;  Realizar atividades relacionadas a projetos de Conservação com a comunidade externa, em âmbito local e transfronteiriço, conforme diretrizes;  Atuar em exposições, eventos, produtos educativos e projetos especiais da área de Educação para Conservação, realizando atividades com públicos diversos;  Atuar com as demais áreas do Parque das Aves no desenvolvimento e execução de atividades e/ou com intuito de contribuir e aprimorar procedimentos e processos relacionados;  Atender, orientar e esclarecer dúvidas do público interno e externo no que se refere aos animais e atuação do Parque das Aves;  Aplicar métodos quantitativos e qualitativos para avaliar a efetividade das atividades;  Registrar informações diárias das atividades e interações com animais para contribuir com relatórios da área; title: Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)
description:

Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)  Location:  Remote  Working Hours:  Monday to Friday, minimum 4 hours overlap with UK GMT  Contract Type:  Independent contractor  You write ads that sell. You can watch a winning VSL and break down exactly why it works. You read ad comments sections for fun. You've written scripts that stopped thumbs, moved product, and hit CPA targets, and you can prove it.  If that sounds like you, keep reading.  About Purolabs  Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We have served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, we are a profitable, fast-growing brand proving that natural wellness can be both effective and transparent.  No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.  The Role  Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We are hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You will develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.  This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You will live inside our ad accounts, study what’s working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.  Beyond individual ad creation, you will build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.  Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.  What You’ll Do  Research & Insight   Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience  Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape  Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology    Creative Development   Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content  Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials  Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators  Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages  Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures    Performance & Iteration   Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities  Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments  Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn’t  Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next    Process & Production   Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control  Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors  Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time  Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators    What We’re Looking For  Essential   3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)  Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results  Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)  Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments  Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows  Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click  Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction  Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini  Excellent written English, clear and persuasive    Nice to Have   Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands  TikTok or YouTube advertising experience  Experience casting and managing UGC creators  Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library  Landing page copywriting or CRO experience  Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)  Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts    You’ll Thrive Here If You Are   Data-obsessed.  You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You would rather test than argue.  Commercially minded.  You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that does not convert is a failed ad.  Fast-moving.  You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.  Proactive.  You do not wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.  Detail-oriented.  Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.  A student of the game.  You are constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what’s working across DTC.    What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)   Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system  You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel  You have made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration  Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly    What We Offer   Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone  Competitive rate based on experience  Paid time off including UK bank holidays  Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results  Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management  A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way  Products that genuinely help people feel better    How to Apply  Your application must include:   Your CV  in English  A portfolio of ad creative work.  Show us ads you have written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.  A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes)  introducing yourself, what you have worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.    This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

About AB InBev Growth Group  Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world. This position involves advanced data handling, business analytics, and stakeholder collaboration. You will be responsible for leading analytical initiatives, ensuring high‑quality data practices, and fostering a data‑driven culture within the organization.  Overall purpose of job:   Integrate and process data from various sources using tools like Databricks, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency.  Clean, transform, and preprocess data to address issues such as missing values, outliers, and data quality inconsistencies.  Apply descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, uplift modeling, and basic machine learning models (regression, classification, clustering) to uncover actionable insights.  Design and implement Power BI dashboards and visualizations to communicate findings in a clear, engaging, and actionable manner.  Collaborate with product managers, engineers, scientists, and business stakeholders to define data requirements and deliver tailored analytical outputs.  Support the development and refinement of data models for forecasting, segmentation, and performance tracking.  Lead analytical projects, define priorities, and make decisions on the best data strategies.  Conduct root‑cause analysis and troubleshoot issues related to data quality and performance.  Promote a culture of continuous improvement through identification of optimization opportunities in processes, KPIs, and data products.  Stay current on emerging trends and technologies in data analytics and contribute to their adoption when relevant.    What you’ll need:   Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or related field. Master’s degree is a plus.  Relevant years of relevant experience in data analysis, preferably in dynamic or digital environments.  Advanced skills in SQL, Python and PySpark.  Hands‑on experience with Databricks and Power BI (mandatory).  Familiarity with data observability concepts and tools.  Strong communication skills to present complex findings to both technical and non‑technical audiences.  Collaborative, detail‑oriented, and proactive in identifying opportunities for data‑driven improvements.  Solid foundation in business analytics and statistical reasoning, including:  Descriptive and inferential statistics  A/B and multivariate testing  Uplift modeling  Predictive modeling (regression, classification)  Clustering techniques    What We Offer:   Performance based bonus*  Attendance Bonus*  Casual office and dress code  Days off*  Health, dental, and life insurance  Discounts on Ambev products*  School materials assurance  Language and training platforms    Equal Opportunity & Affiliated Action:  AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affiliated Action employer. title: Territory Manager - Baixada Santista
description:

Join to apply for the Territory Manager - Baixada Santista  role at Align Technology .  Applicant Privacy Policy  Review our Applicant Privacy Policy  for additional information.  Department:  Sales  Location:  LATAM-Brazil-Sao Paulo  Description  Junte-se a uma equipe que está mudando milhões de vidas  Transformando sorrisos. Transformando vidas. Transformando uma indústria.  Na Align Technology, acreditamos que um grande sorriso pode transformar a vida de uma pessoa. Por isso, criamos uma tecnologia que dá às pessoas a confiança para assumir o próximo passo. Nós revolucionamos a indústria ortodôntica com a introdução do sistema Invisalign, e nunca perdemos de vista esse espírito de inovação. Nossas equipes estão constantemente forçando os limites do que é possível.  Pronto para se juntar a nós?  Sobre essa oportunidade  O Gerente de Território é responsável pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de vendas de um determinado território, buscando proativamente avaliar as necessidades e o potencial de crescimento de uma base de clientes. Tem como objetivo garantir a execução do planejamento de vendas através de análise de segmentação e plano de visitas, dando assistência e criando estratégias para obtenção de resultados positivos em um ambiente desafiador e em crescimento acelerado. Usando todas as ferramentas e estratégias da Align Technology, você será fundamental na comunicação com os clientes.  Responsabilidades   Gerenciar uma geografia definida de contas focando em expandir os negócios e em identificar contas de alto potencial.  Usar ideias e uma abordagem consultiva de vendas para auxiliar aos clientes como inovar em seu setor e com seus clientes; desafie-os a modernizar e expandir seus negócios; ajudá-los na implementação da abordagem da odontologia digital, produtos e soluções da plataforma digital Align e refinar os processos e fluxos de trabalho.  Atingir metas trimestrais e anuais de vendas no território.  Criar, planejar e executar um plano de vendas em um território definido com base no entendimento do potencial de cada conta com foco em atingir o potencial máximo de cada cliente levando em consideração metas, desafios e oportunidades.  Planejar e executar a estratégia de vendas para determinar a visão prática, identificar lacunas e estabelecer soluções para impulsionar o crescimento conforme estratégias de vendas.  Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos positivos com todos os níveis de contas, incluindo funcionários, assistentes e doutores, demonstrando o foco da prática com base na integridade e confiança.  Compreender os recursos da conta para identificar lacunas e fornecer treinamento, recursos técnicos e suporte para garantir que eles estejam bem equipados para tratar pacientes com soluções de alinhamento apropriadas e garantir resultados positivos para os pacientes.  Exceder os objetivos de vendas e estabelecer a segmentação correta do cliente em seu território.  Realizar gestão de orçamento e inserir informações corretamente nos sistemas internos, bem como fazer boa utilização das ferramentas de trabalho da empresa, em conformidade com diretrizes e procedimentos internos.  Colaborar com outras equipes de vendas para aprender e garantir os melhores resultados para o território designado.  Outras atividades podem ser atribuídas ou revisadas conforme evolução e dinâmica dos negócios.    Para esta posição você precisa de…   Superior completo com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas consultivas no mercado de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de capital, digitais, financeiras ou pelo menos 3 anos de experiência relevante em negócios do segmento odontológico, ortodôntico ou comercial B2B relevantes.  Disposição e abertura para aprender de forma sólida o mercado de odontologia digital e forte interesse por tecnologias digitais.  Histórico de realizações de vendas competitivas bem-sucedidas, disposição para enfrentar desafios e trabalhar objeções.  Fortes habilidades de planejamento e organização do trabalho, experiente na criação de planos de ação e execução com maestria.  Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita para guiar e orientar clientes de forma efetiva e gerenciar KOLs.  Habilidade e segurança para discutir negócios (ROI, margens, marketing) e explorar cenários para identificar perfil de clientes e propor as soluções mais adequadas ao momento.  Capacidade de gerenciar expectativas dos clientes e endereçar problemas de forma ágil e resolutiva.  Forte senso de colaboração e trabalho em equipe.  Flexibilidade, adaptabilidade e resiliência para atuar diante de mudanças nas dinâmicas dos negócios.  Carteira de habilitação válida e com disponibilidade para viagens/deslocamentos para reuniões a trabalho, quando necessário.    Educação   Curso superior completo em administração ou voltado a negócios.  Forte conhecimento prático do conjunto de produtos da Microsoft como Word, Excel, Power Point, sistemas de gestão como Salesforce, Concur, Protheus e iOS.  Inglês é desejável.    Equal Opportunity Statement  Align Technology is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all our practices, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected category. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country for which they are applying, and employment eligibility will be verified as a condition of hire. Diferente dos demais processos seletivos, o objetivo principal do banco é reunir pessoas qualificadas para serem consideradas em futuras oportunidades.  Ao se cadastrar, é importante entender que esta é uma possibilidade para vagas que podem surgir a curto, médio ou longo prazo, por isso não temos previsão de quando haverá convocação. Caso haja alguma intercorrência, falha, necessidade de alteração nos dados de contato/currículo ou não recebimento da confirmação por e-mail no momento da inscrição, aconselhamos que o suporte da plataforma seja acionado.   Semestralmente, os candidatos inscritos poderão ser convidados a responder novo formulário de triagem para atualização das informações.
